# MCP registry

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P4 · Agents everywhere](../README.md#phase-4--agents-everywhere) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:mcp-registry` · **Epic:** — · **Tickets:** 6 (1S 5M)

The CP keeps a registry of approved MCP servers: transport, endpoint or command, owner team, versions, approved tool sets, schema pins and binary integrity. Changes are versioned with one-click rollback and go to workers in the signed bundle, so the gateway and `warden mcp` enforce one central list instead of local config.

## How we build it

- Tables `mcp_servers` (id slug, name, transport `http|sse|stdio`, url, command, args, env placeholder names only, owner_team, current_version) and `mcp_server_versions` (server_id, version int, label, approved_tools, schema_pins map tool->sha256 of inputSchema, integrity {sha256, ed25519PublicKey, ed25519Signature}, created_by, approved_by, created_at).
- Schema pin hash uses the same algorithm as `gateway.hashSchema` (sha256 hex of raw inputSchema) so observed inventory hashes from CP `mcpStore` can be imported directly.
- REST: `GET/POST /api/mcp/servers`, `POST /api/mcp/servers/{id}/versions`, `POST /api/mcp/servers/{id}/rollback {version}`, `GET /api/mcp/servers/{id}/versions/{v}/diff`. Writes need editor role; widening (new tools, new URL/command, removed pin) goes through the Phase 2 approval gate.
- Bundle gains `mcpRegistry: [{id, transport, url, command, args, approvedTools, schemaPins, integrity, version}]`; workers keep last-known-good on bad bundles.
- Worker: gateway option `WithRegistry` adds findings `mcp_unregistered_server` and `mcp_unregistered_tool`, and registry pins override per-session baselines for drift; `warden mcp --server <id>` reads integrity from the registry before local `mcp.servers`.

## Done when

An admin registers a server and approves its tools in the console, workers receive it in the signed bundle, and an unapproved tool or schema change is blocked in enforce mode; rollback restores the previous version fleet-wide.

### 1/6 · W-P4-MREG-01

**Add MCP registry data model and store**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Create new package internal/mcpregistry with `Server`, `Version`, `Integrity` types and a `Store` interface (ListServers, GetServer, CreateServer, AddVersion, SetCurrent, ListVersions) on SQLite CP state with migrations. Validate transport-specific fields (url for http/sse, command for stdio), reject secret-looking values in env (only placeholder names), and reuse `config` integrity hex validation from `MCPServerConfig`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Adding a version increments version number and does not change current until SetCurrent
- [ ] stdio server without command is rejected
- [ ] Env values other than placeholder names are rejected

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-MREG-02`](mcp-registry.md#26--w-p4-mreg-02) Add registry REST API with versioning and rollback; [`W-P4-MREG-05`](mcp-registry.md#56--w-p4-mreg-05) Distribute registry in the signed bundle

### 2/6 · W-P4-MREG-02

**Add registry REST API with versioning and rollback**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Expose `/api/mcp/servers` CRUD, `/versions`, `/rollback` and `/versions/{v}/diff` in internal/controlplane behind console session or API key scopes `mcp:read`/`mcp:write`. Diff reports added/removed tools, changed pins and changed transport/endpoint. Every write produces an admin audit record.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Rollback sets current to an older version and audits it
- [ ] Diff lists added and removed tools and changed pins
- [ ] viewer role gets 403 on writes

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-MREG-01`](mcp-registry.md#16--w-p4-mreg-01) Add MCP registry data model and store

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-MREG-03`](mcp-registry.md#36--w-p4-mreg-03) Route widening registry changes through approvals; [`W-P4-MREG-04`](mcp-registry.md#46--w-p4-mreg-04) Build console registry UI with import from inventory

### 3/6 · W-P4-MREG-03

**Route widening registry changes through approvals**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue —

Classify a new version as widening when it adds tools, changes url/command, or drops a pin or integrity field; widening versions are created as pending and need a second approver via the Phase 2 approval flow before SetCurrent. Narrowing changes and rollbacks to a previously approved version apply directly.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Adding a tool requires a second approver
- [ ] Removing a tool applies without approval
- [ ] Self-approval is rejected

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-MREG-02`](mcp-registry.md#26--w-p4-mreg-02) Add registry REST API with versioning and rollback

### 4/6 · W-P4-MREG-04

**Build console registry UI with import from inventory**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Add registry pages to internal/dashboard: server list, server detail with version history and diff, rollback button, and an "import from observed" action that pre-fills tools and schema pins from CP `mcpStore.For(proxyID)` inventory across workers. Pins are only imported for tools the admin ticks.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Import pre-fills tool names and hashes from observed inventory
- [ ] Version history shows who created and approved each version
- [ ] Rollback from UI calls the API and refreshes

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-MREG-02`](mcp-registry.md#26--w-p4-mreg-02) Add registry REST API with versioning and rollback

### 5/6 · W-P4-MREG-05

**Distribute registry in the signed bundle**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Add `mcpRegistry` (current versions only) to the bundle canonical JSON and wire type; include its hash in the ETag. On the worker, parse and validate it in the bundle verifier and store it on the applier so the gateway rebuild in `SettingsApplier.Apply` gets the registry. Bad registry data rejects the whole bundle and keeps last-known-good.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Registry change triggers a new bundle version and ETag
- [ ] Tampered registry fails signature check
- [ ] Worker exposes current registry version in heartbeat

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-MREG-01`](mcp-registry.md#16--w-p4-mreg-01) Add MCP registry data model and store

### 6/6 · W-P4-MREG-06

**Enforce registry tools and pins in gateway and wedge**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Add `gateway.WithRegistry(reg)`: map MCP host (`serverFromSessionKey`) or gateway server id to a registry entry; unregistered servers get `mcp_unregistered_server`, tools outside `approvedTools` get `mcp_unregistered_tool`, and a tools/list hash mismatch against `schemaPins` yields `mcp_schema_drift` with Detail `registry pin`. Behavior follows existing off/monitor/enforce. In cmd/proxy/mcp.go, `--server` resolves integrity from the registry first, then local `mcp.servers`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Enforce mode denies a tool not in approvedTools
- [ ] Pin mismatch is detected on the first tools/list, not only after baseline
- [ ] Wedge refuses a binary whose hash differs from the registry

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-MREG-05`](mcp-registry.md#56--w-p4-mreg-05) Distribute registry in the signed bundle
